messages.subject: Multi-state open robust design

messages.author: dd632bd3bbcdd7e9
messages.subject: Re: Multi-state open robust design
parts:
Hi Lisa,

I don't know if anyone has that at their fingertips.  Do you have an example of BUGS/JAGS code for it?  If so it should translate to NIMBLE easily, since we use nearly the same model language.  If you are just getting started, feel free to send the code on this list and we can advise on any tweaks for NIMBLE.  Our documentation page includes a short guide on that: https://r-nimble.org/documentation-2

You might find good resources in our set of training repositories on GitHub: https://github.com/nimble-training

These include AHMnimble, all of the BUGS/JAGS examples from Kéry and Royle's Applied Hierarchical Modeling Vol. I translated to NIMBLE.

We welcome these questions on this list, but this list is for general NIMBLE software questions.  For ecological hierarchical modeling questions, you might try the hmecology list to see if anyone has BUGS/JAGS code for your model of interest. 

-Perry
